comparison.objective: Set a mechanical metronome to 120 BPM and start it.
comparison.physical_skill: Slide a pendulum weight into a calibrated notch, then initiate escapement motion.
comparison.success_condition: Weight at 120 and metronome ticking hands-free for five seconds.
comparison.reason: Although both set a mechanism and verify motion, this uses a detented sliding weight without locknut countertorque or setting drift under tightening.
